name: Zapper Fuel
label: Quest
description: Zapper Fuel: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're in luck, friend! I've been working on some of my own experiments while Marvon's been gone, and one of them is a short range bug zapper. With just a few adjustments, it should be great for ridding yourself of those Bloodpetal pests.

I can let you have one of my zapper prototypes, but you'll still need to collect the fuel. You can get the necessary Atal'ai haze that the zapper needs in the temple of Atal'Hakkar. The deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes are the ones you'll need to get it from.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This is exhausting, friend. Those things just won't leave me alone!

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, Marvon wasn't around? Well, show me what you got, anyway.
